## Paperclip control loop

This plan is projected as a Paperclip project (`paperclip:` block in
`governance/pmo/plan.yaml`, id `purebliss-crm-voice`). `python3
governance/pmo/cli.py plan --paperclip` renders the full import/sync payload
— project + milestones (each owned by a named Paperclip agent persona:
pmo/cto/hermes/platform-sme, per `registry/personas/offices/cto/delivery-lifecycle.yaml`)
+ one ticket per task, shaped to `docs/contracts/paperclip/ticket.schema.json`
v2 via the same partial-record discipline as
`governance/pmo/dispatch.py::paperclip_ticket_record` (ADR-0014's join node).

**Status of every task is read back from GitHub, never stored here.** GitHub
remains the domain controller behind the join node: a task's `status_source`
is always `github`, and `plan --live` reconciles the plan against live issue
state (rc 1 on a closed task with an unmet milestone, a dependency-order
violation, or a task whose issue does not exist).

`integrations/paperclip/adapters/` today has `heartbeat/`, `approvals/`,
`skills/` — **no adapter that can create or update a live Paperclip
project/tickets**. `sync_adapter_status: not-implemented` in the plan reflects
this; `plan --paperclip` is read-only and never calls out to a live instance.
The gap is tracked in issue #1649 (parent #1268). Until it lands, this
control loop is one-directional: plan -> payload -> (manual/future adapter) ->
Paperclip, with GitHub issue state as the only writable source of truth.

## Fleet hygiene clusters (issue #1575)

22 clusters from `governance/pmo/clusters.json` (sourced from branch
`issue-board-triage-20260920`, not yet on `master`) are ingested as batched
`cluster-*` tasks under M0 (outage/rca), M3 (governance-gate/iac-drift) and M5
(docs/friction/lessons/offshore) — each task's `cluster.members` names every
issue the batch covers, so "everything in one place" includes the fleet's
existing cluster backlog, not only the CRM/voice critical path.
